summary: Fury Gold Mines filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting assay results from its Eau Claire gold project in Quebec. The release details Phase 1 and Phase 2 drill results, including 7.86 g/t gold over 9.43 meters in hole 26EC-103. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is mentioned. The filing is a routine operational update with no special-situations event. The drill results are part of ongoing exploration and resource conversion at the project.
